description: Figure 1 presents a bar chart illustrating the average performance and tokens used by CoUT and baseline Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across four benchmarks. The horizontal axis displays the benchmarks – TruthfulQA, MMLU, HellaSwag, and ARC-Challenge – listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents two metrics: accuracy, measured as a percentage with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100 with tick labels at 20-unit intervals, and tokens, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000 with tick labels at 200-unit intervals. For each benchmark, there are two bars: a blue bar representing CoUT and an orange bar representing the baseline LRM. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each benchmark, with CoUT consistently positioned to the left.  The CoUT bars show accuracy values ranging from approximately 46% on ARC-Challenge to 76% on TruthfulQA, and token counts ranging from approximately 460 on TruthfulQA to 680 on ARC-Challenge. The baseline LRM bars show accuracy values ranging from approximately 42% on ARC-Challenge to 72% on TruthfulQA, and token counts ranging from approximately 420 on TruthfulQA to 660 on ARC-Challenge. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
